Here's a comment for the Wealth Records regarding retirement:
HELP ! !
TBH this is pretty depressing but important points are made. However, times can change; sometimes for the better -  so live in hope (but be as prepared as you can be)..

As long as your mental and body health can handle your job (of course, you don't hate your job).  My suggestion is to keep working until you kick the bucket or you mental or body can no longer handle your job. Only you know yourself.

With the current America politics and global ego-political conditions, you need to save yourself first.  Because no one know what will happen tomorrow, I mean "NO ONE".

You're speaking as if seniors have the option of working longer but ageism in the workplace is real . There's a good chance you'll get fired after a certain age , have a harder time finding you work then your younger peers and have to settle for a lower wage job than what you're used to .You should cover it please  .
